description: QR-heavy known-input byte/format and multi-label compatibility. No decoder calls or outcome filtering; synthetic images, not phone photographs.

provenance.groundTruth: Encoder input bytes and format, with exact printable ASCII text. No byte transcoding to fit decoder output.
provenance.grouping: 10 QR payload groups with four variants each; four other-format groups with two variants each; six two-label scenes; eight unencoded negatives.
provenance.coverageLimits: No explicit ECI, GS1 QR or structured append. Non-ASCII displayed text is recorded but raw bytes define identity.
provenance.evaluationPolicy: Frozen before updated decoder outcomes. Per-case outcomes withheld until implementation freeze.
